forms.title: Deployment cover and ownership card
forms.purpose: Identify this copy, its location, maintainer, revision, and next review.

forms.title: Location and access card
forms.purpose: Give callers and helpers a factual route to the room.

forms.title: Emergency call card
forms.purpose: Externalize the first useful facts while the dispatcher asks questions.

forms.title: Local professional contacts
forms.purpose: Replace generic service categories with verified local names, numbers, hours, access channels, and backups.

forms.title: Comfort inventory
forms.purpose: Make ordinary regulation resources visible before alarm narrows attention.

forms.title: Five-minute values bridge
forms.purpose: Turn one value into one bounded action rather than one heroic life overhaul.

forms.title: Observation and vital-sign log
forms.purpose: Record change and actions for a clinician or dispatcher without treating devices as clearance.

forms.title: Nice-place and low-demand activity map
forms.purpose: Precompute safe, reversible destinations and activities.

forms.title: Safe-place and exit map
forms.purpose: Name exits, meeting points, barriers, transport, and confirmed backups.

forms.title: Medication, power, and care continuity card
forms.purpose: Keep essential dependencies, runtime, approved backups, and escalation routes visible.

forms.title: Household continuity board
forms.purpose: Assign one owner, backup, next check, and escalation for each essential function.

forms.title: Feedback and field-note sheet
forms.purpose: Return corrections, local adaptations, failed routes, and useful inventions upstream.

forms.title: Installation and wet-room audit
forms.purpose: Test water, glare, reach, page turning, privacy, stability, and visibility in the actual room.

forms.title: Route drill and timing log
forms.purpose: Run a calm-time scenario and record where finding, choosing, writing, calling, or handing off becomes slow or ambiguous.

forms.title: First-aid figure usability review
forms.purpose: Test whether CPR, AED, recovery-position, and triage figures produce the intended action without coaching from the author.

forms.title: Maintenance and replacement inspection
forms.purpose: Record physical damage, stale local facts, missing supplies, used forms, and the next replacement action.

forms.title: Blank remarks and handoff sheet
forms.purpose: Provide writable space without hiding it inside a content page.

forms.title: Quiet activity sheet
forms.purpose: Offer dot-grid drawing, a card-house challenge, and a simple paper-folding practice without pretending they are treatment.
